features: Adds Apply Screen Settings to Real and Test Projection Control
Persists screen format, density and custom LED resolution per scoring round and data mode
Adds Reset to 16:9 Default with Maximum Density
Custom width and height are enabled only when Custom Resolution is selected
Applied settings are reused automatically by all projection buttons for the current round
Shows applied layout summary including format, density, calculated columns, rows and page count
Test and Real projector settings are isolated while using the same shared ProjectionSettingsService
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
